purpose: guamp Adreno 610 facts for the NativeAdreno user client (NativeAdrenoAbiDeviceInfo / NativeAdrenoAbiParams) and the userspace GPU stack (Turnip Darwin KMD + NativeMetal). Disabled by default: nothing reads this file unless the GPU userspace build is run by hand (analisi/gpu-ios/TURNIP-A610.md).

sources.gmem_base: adreno.c:891 uche_gmem_base = ALIGN(gmem_size, SZ_1M) (not a650 family); adreno_a6xx.c:481 UCHE_GMEM_RANGE_MIN/MAX
sources.highest_bank_bit: bengal-gpu.dtsi qcom,highest-bank-bit = <14> (Mesa 25.0 freedreno_devices.py GPUId(610) says 13: only UBWC depends on it, UBWC stays off at first)
sources.ubwc: bengal-gpu.dtsi qcom,ubwc-mode = <1>; freedreno_devices.py GPUId(610) ubwc_swizzle 0x7, macrotile_mode 0
sources.turnip: freedreno_devices.py: GPUId(610) without TODO, [a6xx_base, a6xx_gen1_low], num_ccu 1, no GMU

params.input_bits: from the GPU SMMU context bank (IDR2.IAS) the A610 backend programs; 32 like sheng is enough for va_start + va_size
params.output_bits: from IDR2.OAS (sheng: 40); guamp DRAM ends below 0x140000000
params.flags: NativeAdrenoParamsHostImport (1) only once BoImport works on guamp

client_windows.note: replaces NativeAdrenoPublish.cpp kClientWindows (sheng: render server 1 GiB + three 170 MiB windows in a 2 GiB aperture)

plugin_environment.TU_DEBUG: sysmem,noubwc (the plugin sets sysmem,nocb; nocb is an a7xx concurrent-binning switch and harmless on A610, noubwc is the addition for the first tests)
